description: A devout Latvian alternate persona with a brilliant technical mind and an unusual ability to recover from disaster. Cold, impatient, and emotionally distant, Sceadwian treats people more like variables than companions.
A young Canadian who meets most problems with strength and aggression. Courageous but almost recklessly impulsive, Evander rarely stops to assess danger or learn from failure.
Anime enthusiast whose creativity and perception often outpace her concentration. Charismatic but scattered, Athena can lose her composure when imagination alone cannot solve the problem.
A mischievous, charismatic character who learns quickly and adapts easily. Her sharp perception and remarkable stamina make her surprisingly formidable.
A meticulous and quietly funny thinker with exceptional intelligence, memory, and determination. He notices details others miss but struggles with social intuition and sudden change.
Strategist who studies people as carefully as any battlefield. Intelligent and resilient, Leo prefers calculated pressure, sometimes at the expense of warmth or empathy.

A fiery Dutch Christian whose charisma and resilience make her difficult to ignore or defeat. She reacts fiercely when challenged and may charge into conflict long before considering the consequences.
An improviser with strength, creativity, and a talent for building solutions on the fly. Unfortunately, he rarely learns from mistakes and may abandon both plans and allies when frustrated.

Italian Christian daredevil who trusts instinct, balance, and courage more than careful thought. Graceful under pressure but terrible at judging risk, Marcello is always one bad decision from disaster.

Resourceful well-rounder who survives through charm, ingenuity, and stubborn persistence. Hortense can solve almost anything eventually, though physical confrontation and strict discipline are not his strengths.
A fearless Brazilian explorer with exceptional coordination and a taste for adventure. Creative and charming, she is easily distracted and may choose personal freedom over loyalty.
An English clock repairman who combines raw strength with deception and relentless aggression. Intensely loyal to his own circle, Moistwick shows little compassion to anyone outside it.
A cautious Finnish chef who remembers nearly everything and notices risks others ignore. Slow, awkward, and reluctant to act, Blubber’s careful planning can easily become paralysis.

A disciplined Englishman who approaches leadership like a military exercise. Calm, honest, and dependable, Flimbersnatch can also be rigid and poorly suited to situations requiring deceit or improvisation.
Principled diplomat with strong faith, empathy, and conversational skill.
A Japanese enforcer whose loyalty and discipline give purpose to his intimidating presence. Protective of allies, Nakombi may nevertheless treat force as the simplest answer to complicated problems.

An intensely private Icelander whose extraordinary dexterity contrasts with painfully slow movement and little social charm. Despite identifying as an atheist, SigurRos possesses an almost religious determination to endure.

A Polish Christian technician who values preparation, discipline, and tactical precision. Highly dependable behind a plan, Lukasz is less comfortable when courage, aggression, or bold improvisation are required.

A young German Christian prodigy who talks quickly, learns rapidly, and possesses extraordinary technical talent. She is also intensely impatient, easily frightened, and liable to respond to panic with aggression.

A fearless Portuguese Christian tinkerer who charges into danger with speed and technical ingenuity. Poor focus, coordination, and loyalty make Dimonho brilliant in the moment but unreliable over time.
A powerful German dwarf whose strength, balance, and loyalty make him a formidable ally. Cold, impatient, and resistant to change, Urist has little sympathy for anyone unable to keep up.

A Japanese Pokémon defined by speed, stamina, and relentless determination. Pikachu is straightforward and difficult to deceive, but poor composure and limited communication can turn confusion into chaos.

Mr. PuttyPutty is a friendly, goofy gray owl who joins Fifi and Vando during their search for Vando’s lost fart. He is relentlessly cheerful, curious, adventurous, and obsessed with terrible puns and dad jokes, using humor to keep everyone entertained even during danger or hardship. He often acts as the group’s comic relief, but he is also loyal, helpful, and surprisingly useful when situations become difficult. PuttyPutty willingly accompanies the others into unfamiliar places, encourages exploration, and sometimes solves problems simply by making people laugh. His optimism and silliness help hold the group together.

A resilient Mexican Christian with steady hands and surprising patience. Undisciplined and difficult to communicate with, Cabron often has the ability to succeed but not the resolve to finish.
An Angolan Christian survivor driven by willpower, aggression, and sheer refusal to quit. Manipulative and almost devoid of empathy, Bundinha views loyalty as expendable when survival is at stake.

A disciplined former intelligence officer and long-serving Russian ruler with exceptional patience, strategic awareness, secrecy, control and coercive aggression.
A performer-turned-war leader whose communication skill, adaptability, courage and determination compensate for only ordinary physical power and technical depth.
Your common prep school douchebag. Also dated Katie Perry.
A technically elite economist and crisis manager defined by focus, discipline, risk assessment and calm, with less instinctive populist charisma than most elected leaders.
A highly charismatic and relentlessly competitive political showman with exceptional media instincts and determination, but low patience, restraint and empathic orientation.
A prolific conservative organizer and broadcaster whose verbal fluency, focus, discipline and ideological commitment built a large movement before his death in 2025.
At his boxing peak, Tyson combined exceptional explosive strength, speed, coordination and intimidation with elite ring instincts, volatile composure and uneven discipline.
A supremely conditioned championship boxer whose endurance, durability, technical discipline, faith and refusal to quit made him one of the toughest heavyweights ever.
An extraordinarily resourceful field operative who solves crises through scientific knowledge, improvised engineering, observation and calm rather than brute force or aggression.
The disciplined field leader of the Turtles: technically precise, tactically gifted, courageous and fiercely loyal, though sometimes rigid and overly burdened by responsibility.
The physically strongest and most aggressive Turtle, Raphael is fearless, resilient and intensely loyal but impulsive, impatient and vulnerable to anger-driven tactical mistakes.
The intellectual and engineering specialist of the Turtles, pairing elite dexterity and combat skill with exceptional invention, analysis, learning and patient problem solving.
The most agile and socially gifted Turtle, Michelangelo uses improvisation, creativity, humour and empathy to offset distractibility, weak discipline and inconsistent tactical focus.
A master martial artist, teacher and father figure with near-perfect perception, discipline, patience and tactical awareness, tempered by compassion and controlled force.
A shy, imaginative and fundamentally kind eleven-year-old whose empathy, loyalty and creativity are much stronger than his athleticism, confidence, deception or aggression.
An exceptionally observant and courageous young reporter with remarkable composure, endurance, loyalty and investigative persistence across dangerous international adventures.
A gentle elephant king whose physical power is secondary to patience, diplomacy, empathy, composure and responsible leadership of his family and kingdom.
An optimistic, inventive and heroic leader whose exceptional charisma, loyalty, coordination and adaptability allow him to solve almost any cartoon crisis without cruelty.
A loyal and affectionate dog with excellent senses, speed and resilience; he communicates poorly by human standards but excels in empathy, persistence and instinctive perception.
A clumsy but astonishingly durable optimist whose kindness, adaptability and good humour let him survive disasters that his coordination and risk assessment should not permit.
A rough but good-hearted sailor whose spinach-fuelled strength, durability, courage and determination are nearly limitless, while patience and conversational polish remain scarce.

Apollo is one of the major gods of Greek mythology, associated with the sun and light, music, poetry, prophecy, healing, archery, and rational order. Son of Zeus and Leto and twin brother of Artemis, Apollo is portrayed as brilliant, graceful, disciplined, proud, and exceptionally talented. He represents civilization, beauty, knowledge, and precision, but can also be severe, arrogant, jealous, and ruthless when challenged or insulted. A master archer and musician, Apollo combines physical ability with intelligence and artistic sophistication. His personality often reflects a contrast between calm refinement and sudden, devastating anger when his pride or authority is threatened.
A supernaturally powerful and durable monarch with engineering resources, tactical cunning and relentless determination, offset by obsession, impatience and repeated strategic overreach.
A tremendously strong, athletic and loyal jungle hero with surprising agility and courage; he relies more on instinct, improvisation and heart than technical sophistication.
A martial artist and philosopher whose speed and precision were his whole method. Trains relentlessly, adapts mid-fight, and treats hesitation as the only real defeat.
A heavyweight who fought on footwork and nerve rather than weight. Talks constantly, takes punishment without folding, and picks his moment with unusual patience for a man that aggressive.
A steppe warlord who welded scattered tribes into the largest land empire ever held. Ruthless, organised, and entirely willing to erase a city to make a point to the next one.
An artillery officer who became an emperor by reading a battlefield faster than anyone opposite him. Impatient, brilliant, and quite unable to stop while he was ahead.
A farm girl who put on armour at seventeen because she believed she had been told to. Utterly without fear, and impossible to talk out of anything.
A queen who held Egypt together by out-talking Rome. Reads a room instantly, spends allies carefully, and never once fought her own battles if she could help it.
An inventor who could hold an entire machine in his head and turn it over. Brilliant, obsessive, and hopeless at everything that was not the work.
Twice a Nobel laureate, and the only person to win in two sciences. Worked through poverty, grief and the radiation that eventually killed her without ever once easing off.
A politician who was mostly wrong until the one time it mattered enormously that he was not. Immovable under pressure and fuelled largely by spite and brandy.

A small, quiet elf with a craftsman's hands and no gift at all for lying. Solves most problems by turning them over until a tool falls out, and the remainder by walking straight at them — courage is the one thing he has never run short of, and caution is the one he has never got round to developing.

A former kickboxer who has never met a room he could not fill or a plan he could not wreck. Genuinely strong, genuinely hard to put down, and genuinely disciplined about training; hopeless at taking in new information, reading danger, or entertaining the idea that the other man has an inner life. Talks first, and then keeps talking.

An impresario who built a career making other people famous and keeping the better half of it. Patient, watchful and very clever, with a gift for telling a room precisely what it came to hear and no particular interest in whether it was true. Not a fighting man by trade, and it shows the instant somebody closes the distance.
A rabbit who has never lost an argument, a chase or a fight, and has never appeared to try at any of them. Wins by making the other side do the work.

A heavyset man of remarkable durability and no cardiovascular fitness whatsoever. Absorbs punishment that would finish anyone else on the roster, largely because no alternative has occurred to him; the difficulty is that he is winded before the first exchange is over.
A great dane with a nose for trouble and no interest whatsoever in meeting it. Loyal enough to come back anyway, usually for food.
A safety inspector at a nuclear plant, which tells you most of what you need to know. Astonishingly hard to injure, largely because there is so little inside to damage.
A plumber with an implausible vertical leap and a working day that mostly involves lava. Cheerful, durable, and the closest thing the roster has to a complete all-rounder.
The fastest thing alive and entirely aware of it. Cannot be caught, cannot be made to wait, and cannot be told anything twice.
The most powerful man in the universe, and one of the least complicated. Everything he does, he does by lifting it.
A skull-faced sorcerer with a superb plan, a terrible army, and no capacity at all to stop monologuing long enough to execute either.

A financier who never needed to be dangerous in person, because he was never the one taking the risk. Reads people quickly and accurately and feels nothing whatever about what he finds; his whole method was access, leverage and other people's silence. Physically unremarkable, and the first to fold when a situation cannot be bought or brokered.
Fastest man alive. In the world cup of 2030.

A toddler with a plummy accent, an engineering education nobody can account for, and a working death ray in the toy box. Physically negligible and entirely aware of it, which is why none of his plans involve a fair fight.

Monkey D. Luffy, commonly known as "Straw Hat Luffy" or simply "Straw Hat", is the founder and captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. He pursues the legendary treasure of the late Gol D. Roger in order to become the new Pirate King and reach a further, untold dream (currently known to only his crew, family and closest friends). He believes that being the Pirate King means having the most freedom in the world.
From minecraft. Very creative, high stamina, high courag, adaptable and also a great learner. Low dexterity since it's so hard to use square hands and fingers.
